access: DuckDB ATTACH AS alphalake (READ_ONLY); USE alphalake

queries.standard_periods: SELECT CAST(report_period AS VARCHAR) period,count(*) facts,count(DISTINCT instrument_id) instruments,count(DISTINCT instrument_id) FILTER(WHERE source_provider_field='FN230') revenue_instruments FROM fundamental.fact GROUP BY report_period ORDER BY report_period
queries.provider_periods: SELECT CAST(report_period AS VARCHAR) period,count(DISTINCT provider_code) codes FROM fundamental.provider_fact WHERE provider_field='FN230' GROUP BY report_period ORDER BY report_period
queries.observation_bounds: SELECT CAST(min(ingested_at) AS VARCHAR) first_standard_ingestion,CAST(max(ingested_at) AS VARCHAR) last_standard_ingestion,CAST(min(announcement_time) AS VARCHAR) first_announcement,CAST(max(announcement_time) AS VARCHAR) last_announcement FROM fundamental.fact
queries.source_observations: SELECT CAST(min(a.fetched_at) AS VARCHAR) earliest_retained_artifact_fetch,CAST(max(a.fetched_at) AS VARCHAR) latest_retained_artifact_fetch,count(DISTINCT a.artifact_id) artifacts FROM meta.artifact a JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT artifact_id FROM fundamental.provider_fact WHERE provider_field='FN230') p USING(artifact_id)
queries.schema: SELECT max(version) AS schema_version FROM meta.schema_version

boundaries: 主库留存覆盖审计，不是预测误差或原文逐公司验收
ingested_at为当前物化记录时间，不据此推断首次取得
源artifact取得不证明历史报告期当时已留存该版本
